description: This Java source file defines the MockServerRule class, which implements JUnit's TestRule to manage the lifecycle of a MockServer during tests. It includes constructors for different configurations, methods to retrieve server ports, and internal logic to start, stop, and reset mock servers, as well as inject clients into test classes.
